0.text: Why do you trouble an Old woman? Your kind have stolen more than enough from me Enforcer…
I want to help, I now know.
You want to help? But your crest… Oh, could it be that an end is finally approaching? It was my son, Enforcer. They took my boy.

1.text: Years have passed now, but it still haunts my dreams. A plague had swept Narrow Orchard, and I was among the sick. My son bought me medicine, instead of paying his tithe to the Order.

2.text: If he hadn’t I would surely have died. And so, as punishment, they accused him of witchcraft....

3.text: One night they came and they took him from our home. Abducted my poor boy. A few days later, some men found him floating in Kingsport Lake. He'd been tortured...

4.text: My boy… My poor boy… They said tithing was important… What about my son…. You must turn away before it's too late!
